text:
Maya (CSM): @Ari quick health check — onboarding metrics look good overall but we saw a 25% latency tail increase this week on your chat route. worried it might affect the upcoming pilot expansion. any constraints on trying a model switch or q-config?

Jamal (Solutions Eng): can confirm. common fast wins: 1) q4_0 quantized variant of the current model, 2) route short completion requests to a smaller model (embedding or assistant-lite), 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated contexts. example routing snippet we can push to your config:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "short_reply", tokens: "<128"}
    target: redwood/llama-3-8b-q4
  - match: {intent: "long_gen"}
    target: redwood/llama-3-70b
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Ari (StratusX): thanks. short gen percentage is ~42% for our billing flow. note: were on Private deployment in eu-west, and SSO/PII rules mean we need to avoid any model variants not vetted by security. can we run a canary on 5% first? also prefer no change to current throughput limits.

Priya (Product): 5% canary is the right approach. we can create a canary policy: start at 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h if latency and error rate are stable. metrics to watch: p95 latency, request_error_rate, quality_regression_score (using your eval set). fallback: auto-switch back after 15m if p95 increases >20%.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): for Private + security, we can provision the q4 build that passes our internal checksum/vetting. rollout plan I recommend:
- stage1: q4 model with identical tokenizer, KV cache on
- stage2: enable route small_replies -> q4 (1% canary)
- stage3: increase to 5% after 2h if stable
- stage4: monitor quality via the eval hooks (we'll surface diffs)

Quick config snippet for canary:```json
{
  "canary": {"percent": 1, "monitor": ["p95","error_rate","quality_diff"]},
  "auto_rollback": {"p95_increase_pct": 20, "window_mins": 15}
}
```

Maya (CSM): Ari — can we schedule a 30min enablement call tomorrow to walk through the config push + security signoff? Ill invite Jamal + Priya. also capturing feedback: are there any UX changes your team expects if replies get slightly shorter with quant? wed like to note that for renewal conversation.

Ari (StratusX): tomorrow 10:30 CET works. regarding UX: product team has a strict tone checklist, but shortness is ok as long as completeness stays. wed like to see a small A/B on length vs completion for the billing flow. renewal: were evaluating cost/perf — if we get stable p95 improvement without quality regressions that favors renewal.

Priya (Product): noted — well add a short A/B probe to the canary to track completion rate and average token usage. please share 5 golden prompts you care about and well include them in the eval set.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window in eu-west tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. if canary overlaps well freeze rollouts during maintenance.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): action items: 1) create q4 build with security checksum (we own) 2) push canary routing config (1% then 5%) 3) set up eval probes and dashboards (quality + cost) 4) run enablement call with StratusX tomorrow 10:30 CET. Ill prepare the playbook and rollback commands (`redwood rollback --route chat --to stable`).

Maya (CSM): great. Ari Ill send calendar invite and a short pre-read with the config we plan to apply. any immediate objections? :raised_hands:

Ari (StratusX): none. thanks, team. excited to see if this reduces token spend and p95.

Maya (CSM): capturing feedback for renewal notes: near-term goal = improve p95 by 15-25% and reduce tokens per short_reply by ~20% without quality regression. well surface results in the renewal brief. :rocket:
